shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work and hauling, linked weather and power, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency). DBH and VEF PipeSystem support as SOFT compat (detect, never require).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics.
- Basement: 100% solid mineable rock, fogged, thick-roofed; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches (ui, levelGen, rendering, movement, logistics, roofSync, weather, power); fail open everywhere.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (T0-T3 signed off; T4 in progress)
- Core: LevelComp registry on aligned pocket maps; stairs pairs generate levels; loss-proof StairTransfer for pawns and cargo; PageUp/PageDown level view.
- Sky mountains: contracted mass, ledge ring, lit face rows, fogged core, guaranteed mining reveal.
- See-below renderer: WHITELISTED content layers only at y=-2.5 (exact types: terrain, terrain edges, things general, buildings damage, snow, sand, gas, pollution cloud, edge and sun shadows, bridge props, terrain scatter where present). Overlays of every kind (vanilla power grid, plans, DBH pipes, VEF pipes, unknown future mods) are excluded by construction and only ever render on the viewed level. Air-cells light mask; live dynamic things below; far clip 70.
- Weather link: sky adopts ground weather every 150 ticks.
- Live sync (MapEvents): roof/rooftop coupling, floor-to-roof writes, fall-through over air.
- Cross-level work, idle return, drafted gizmos, colony-wide tables.
- Cross-level hauling: storage-driven + construction-demand-driven with quantity-aware pinning; right-click haul orders; virtual pawn AND item re-seating for storage queries (lore-saved technique).
- Cross-level needs: bed redirect; hunger/joy via idle-return.
- One-colony resources: column-wide counts.
- Power across levels (T4a): stairwells transmit power (conduits connect on both levels); CompABPowerBridge balances the pair's nets every 30 ticks, deficit side receives up to 90% of the other side's surplus, master side per pair computes, outputs decay to zero when unlinked or balanced. Kill switch: power.

## Quadruple pass log
T4a: whitelist exact-type matching audited (power overlay subclasses the things layer, inheritance matching would readmit it); bridge convergence audited (own-output feedback excluded). Confidence: whitelist 93%, power bridge 82% (battery-swing flicker is the live-test question).
Known gaps: DBH and VEF pipe NET bridging not yet built (next: decompile their net managers, bridge through stairwells, companion-mod compat test); bills cross-level fetch; patient beds; renderer polish backlog.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T3 DONE. T4a CODE DONE (awaiting test).
- T4b: DBH plumbing bridge + VEF PipeSystem bridge (soft compat) + companion-mod test run.
- T4c: temperature sync, threat policy, map-removal cleanup, profiling.
- Publishing prep per global rules.

## Status
T4a compiled green, pushed. Pending test: no overlay bleed from any level, power flowing between levels through linked stairwells.
